description:
Demenova 

is two worlds, one looking up at space, the other looking down at the soil. 

I believe space science can reach every field, and I'm here to prove it; starting with agriculture."Our name blends Demeter, the Greek goddess of agriculture, with nova, a new star.”

As for myself, I'm going in solo. I'm a Ecuadorean mechanical engineer student with a strong fascination on full-stack development and practical applications for propulsion based systems. 

Currently studying in Spain
